'''Cdera''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer who served at the primary customs checkpoint on [[Sarahwiee]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Chief Duty Officer Cdera was on duty when [[Tere Metallo]], [[Gil Crosear]], and [[Alexandra Winger|Alex Winger]] arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in an [[Mission to Sarahwiee|effort to rescue]] [[Carl Barzon]].<ref name="SWAJ6" />
